title: CAREER EXPERIENCE DRIVE INTERN-HR ANALYTICS & HRIS
desc:
Eczacıbaşı Holding
Established by Dr. Nejat F. Eczacıbaşı in 1942, Eczacıbaşı Group is one of Turkey's leading industrial conglomerates, operating primarily in construction products, consumer products, healthcare, and natural resources sectors for both national and international markets. It has a total of 50 entities, including one foreign partnership, more than 13,500 employees also engaging in real estate development, natural resources, and information technology.
What Do We Expect from Our New Team Member
Assist in the control, organization, and analysis of Human Resources data.
Contribute to reporting and dashboard work related to headcount, turnover, recruitment, and other key HR metrics.
Support the development, testing, and data validation of Power BI dashboards.
Assist in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and currency of employee and organizational data in HRIS systems, primarily SAP SuccessFactors.
Contribute to HRIS master data, data quality, and data governance initiatives.
Support the identification of needs in SAP SuccessFactors and other HR systems, as well as the tracking of developments, testing/UAT, and user acceptance processes.
Contribute to the control and improvement of data flows between HR systems and reporting and analytics platforms.
Support the exploration of digitization, automation, and artificial intelligence opportunities in HR processes.
Contribute to HR Analytics and HRIS projects in collaboration with HR, IT, and other stakeholders.
What kind of teammate are we looking for?
If you are a 4th-year student in one of the following departments: Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering, Management Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or related fields,
If you can commit to an internship for at least 3.5 days a week for a long-term period,
If you enjoy working with data, analyzing it, and deriving meaningful insights from the results,
If you are confident in your Excel skills,
If you have an interest or basic experience with analytical tools such as Power BI, SQL, or Python,
If you are curious about technology, artificial intelligence, and digital HR applications,
If you pay attention to detail and are eager to learn and research,
If you have a good level of English,
And if you reside in Istanbul.
What is here for you?
At Eczacıbaşı, you can steadily improve your personal, professional, and technical competencies by participating in training programs that support you and your career.
You will have access to opportunities for rotation among more than 50 companies and global experience in over 120 international markets.
Vacation time at Eczacıbaşı is calculated according to seniority based on your total work experience. Your bring your seniority with you.
We will always recognize your success through different reward methods.
You can take advantage of location-independent or hybrid work opportunities through different work models suitable to the nature of your job, and you can determine your own work schedule with flexible work hours. We offer technology and ergonomic support packages to Eczacıbaşı employees who work remotely full-time.
As a new parent working at Eczacıbaşı, you are privileged. Eczacıbaşı employees who are mothers are provided with monthly nursery support; Eczacıbaşı employees who are fathers are entitled to a 3-week paternity leave.
People who savor culture and art are here! Thanks to the Eczacıbaşı Group’s founding sponsorship of Istanbul Modern, Turkey's first modern and contemporary art museum, you can visit the museum for free. Additionally, thanks to Eczacıbaşı Group’s founding sponsorship of Istanbul Foundation for Culture and Arts (İKSV), you can also enjoy the privilege and discounts of İKSV’s Lale Card to all İKSV events.
You can participate in Eczacıbaşı’s volunteering activities, every one of which prioritizes social benefit, and get involved in projects that create social impact.
We are committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment. We value diversity and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or seniority.
